title: Canonical flat scalar Hom comparison and evaluation-roof data
statement: On a site small in the module universe, use the normalized scalar, closed tensor-Hom and representative models [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], and the strict normalized Hom comparison and denominator [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models], [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof]. For a commutative coefficient map $a:R\to S$, define $c:E_a^L H_R(K,L)\to H_S(E_a^LK,E_a^LL)$ to be the transpose of the inverse strong scalar tensor comparison followed by scalar-extended evaluation. Define its restriction using the normalized scalar-Hom adjunction. Use the actual restricted regular $S$-module for strict tensoring; define the exact-extension representative comparison using the universal derived counit, termwise restriction and the tensor identification. Define the source and target representative maps by this comparison and the fixed Hom-resolution isomorphisms. Keep the recorded strict numerator and denominator, and define the inverse localized denominator only when it is a quasi-isomorphism. Define EvaluationRoof to be the data type of a tensor/restricted-extension identification fixed on pure tensors, together with the assertions that exact extension computes derived extension; the denominator is a quasi-isomorphism on flat-term K-flat first inputs; the restricted comparison satisfies both the denominator equation and equivalent numerator/inverse-denominator roof; and these maps are natural in both inputs and compatible with coefficient composition, including identity maps. This packages data and properties and does not assert that the type is inhabited.
